title: Localization record
description: One canonical record. record_id is logical and stable: it must not change when the text changes, when a translation is edited, or when an update ships new wording for the same slot. Content and source version live in their own fields.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source archive this record was read from.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of this record's text only; changes whenever the text changes.

source_version.description: Layer or release the record came from (for example switch-base, switch-update).

scene.description: Scene id taken from the source namespace (ST_<scene>).

seq.description: Order of the line inside its scene, from the source key.

speaker.description: Character id when proven by an asset-level source; UNKNOWN otherwise.

branch.description: Choice token when the shipped sequencer assets prove one (for example Choice2).

scene_asset_dir.description: Sequencer directory the build ships for this scene, from the cooked file manifest.
